payload.subject: Cutting cost-per-lead in half with AI
payload.html:
Hey {{first_name}},


Most independent service-based businesses are still paying top dollar per lead while competitors quietly cut that number in half. The difference usually isn't the offer — it's whether AI is doing the outreach and qualification work before the phone ever rings.


Businesses pairing AI-driven outreach with a real human on the qualification call are seeing up to a 60% reduction in lead generation costs, alongside a 50% increase in sales-ready leads. One cohort of programs using this exact combo dropped their cost-per-booked-meeting from $312 down to $94 — a 70% cut — in a single year. Separately, 64% of businesses using AI chatbots report more qualified leads coming through the door, with real-time responses lifting conversion rates by up to 20%. The lever isn't working harder on each lead — it's letting AI filter and warm up the volume so your time only goes to the ones worth it.

Talk soon,
Dylan | Digigrowth
